CellIri.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI in the cell/ namespace (https://w3id.org/battinfo/cell/xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

DatasetIri.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI in the dataset/ namespace (https://w3id.org/battinfo/dataset/xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

DatasetLink.description: Link to a dataset record, with the role the dataset plays for this record.

id.description: Canonical IRI of the linked dataset record.

role.description: Role of the linked dataset as a whole relative to this record (record level; the per-file role lives on the dataset's distribution entries).

FlexDate.description: Date as an ISO 8601 string (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD) or a Unix timestamp in seconds.

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 calendar date string: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

Funding.description: Funding project (grant) under which the record was produced. Maps to schema:funding / schema:Grant in JSON-LD.

same_as.description: External identifier IRI for the funder (e.g. a ROR or DOI funder IRI).

id.description: Resolvable IRI of the grant (e.g. a CORDIS project IRI).

identifier.description: Grant number as assigned by the funder (e.g. '101069765').

Organization.description: An organization referenced by name, with an optional canonical BattINFO organization IRI.

same_as.description: External identifier IRI for this organization (e.g. ROR or Wikidata).

Person.description: A person, in schema.org Person terms; an ORCID may be given in same_as.

affiliation.description: Organization the person is affiliated with.

same_as.description: External identifier IRI, typically an ORCID (https://orcid.org/...).

ShortId.description: Short human-friendly identifier derived from the record IRI (Crockford base32, 6-16 characters).

UnixTime.description: Unix timestamp in whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

description: A physical cell realizing a cell spec.

batch_id.description: Production or lab batch this cell belongs to.

battery_status.description: Current status of the battery per EU Battery Regulation Annex XIII.

cell_spec_id.description: IRI of the cell spec this physical cell realizes.

conformance.description: Assessment of how well this record followed the spec that governs it.

deviations.description: Individual deviations from the governing spec or protocol.

duration_s.description: Duration of the deviation in seconds.

impact.description: Assessed impact severity of the deviation.

occurred_at.description: When the deviation occurred (ISO 8601 string or Unix timestamp).

step_index.description: Zero-based protocol step during which the deviation occurred.

type.description: Specific deviation label within the category (free text).

counter_electrode_id.description: Canonical IRI of the electrode record built into this cell as its counter electrode. In a half cell that electrode is also the reference electrode, so it is emitted with both role classes.

dpp_status.description: Status of this digital product passport record.

expires_at.description: Expiration / best-before date. ISO 8601 string (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD) or Unix timestamp.

grade.description: Quality grade assigned to this cell (e.g. 'A', 'B', 'C', 'reject').

id.description: Canonical IRI of this cell instance.

manufactured_at.description: Production date. ISO 8601 string (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD) or Unix timestamp.

name.description: Human-readable name / label for this cell (e.g. a lab batch ID). The primary identifier; usually present even without a manufacturer serial number.

serial_number.description: Manufacturer serial number (unique within the product model); optional.

service_start_date.description: ISO 8601 date when the battery was first put into service.

supersedes.description: IRI of the previous cell record this passport replaces, e.g. after repurposing.

working_electrode_id.description: Canonical IRI of the electrode record (the physical batch or disc) built into this cell as its working electrode. The cell spec says which electrode design the cell uses; this says which built electrode went into this individual cell.

contributor.description: People who contributed this record to the platform (attribution/provenance). Each is a schema:Person; an ORCID may be given in same_as. Distinct from data authorship (creators).

datasets.description: Datasets recorded for this cell. Back-reference to dataset records. dataset.about is the source of truth for what a dataset describes; when records are saved together through a workspace the library fills this list from each dataset's cell and test links, and hand-authored records may set it directly.

funding.description: Funding project (grant) under which the record was produced.

license.description: License under which this record and its data are released, as an SPDX license identifier (e.g. "cc-by-4.0") or a license URL. Stamped from the workspace default (ws.license) and emitted as dcterms:license in JSON-LD.

measured.description: Measured cell properties using the same keys as the spec's properties map; read each key as the value measured for this cell (e.g. nominal_capacity = measured discharge capacity, mass = weighed mass).

notes.description: Free-text notes carried with the record.

provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.

battinfo_version.description: Version of the battinfo library that wrote this record (semantic versioning); stamped on save.

citation.description: Resolvable citation target to use for attribution, typically a DOI URL.

citation_doi.description: DOI of the source publication (bare '10.xxxx/...' form). Prefer provenance.citation with a DOI resolver URL.

curated_by.description: Name or identifier of the person who curated this record.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source file, for integrity verification.

retrieved_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC) when the source was retrieved or the record was captured.

source_file.description: Filename or path of the source file, when the record was derived from a file.

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the source (document title, instrument, lab, or system).

source_type.description: Kind of source this record was created from.

source_url.description: URL of the source document or landing page, when available.

workflow_version.description: Version of the ingest/curation workflow that produced this record.

schema_version.description: Version of the record schema this document conforms to (semantic versioning); stamped by the library on save.
